Set categories

- Initial release: research business and software reputation using the Crawlora API, returning normalized JSON.
- Supports Product Hunt (launches, makers, alternatives), Trustpilot (business reviews), TrustMRR (revenue-verified startups), and Capterra (software reviews/alternatives).
- Enables vendor due diligence, launch retrospectives, startup revenue checks, and product review aggregation.
- No scraping needed; uses official Crawlora API endpoints only.
- Includes setup steps for acquiring an API key and instructions for API usage.
